entities.name: Djibril Bassolé
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Djibrill Yipènè Bassolé is a Burkinabé politician and diplomat. He served in the government of Burkina Faso as Minister of Security from 2000 to 2007 and as Minister of Foreign Affairs and Regional Cooperation from 2007 to 2008. Bassolé was the Joint African Union-United Nations Chief Mediator for Darfur from 2008 to 2011, and the Burkinabé Minister of Foreign Affairs for a second time from 2011 to 2014.

entities.summary: Djibrill Yipènè Bassolé is a Burkinabé politician and diplomat. He served in the government of Burkina Faso as Minister of Security from 2000 to 2007 and as Minister of Foreign Affairs and Regional Cooperation from 2007 to 2008. Bassolé was the Joint African Union-United Nations Chief Mediator for Darfur from 2008 to 2011, and the Burkinabé Minister of Foreign Affairs for a second time from 2011 to 2014.
